_comment: The ladder's 30 characters — one per rung, faced exactly once.
Single source of truth for BOTH the `bots` table (tools/roster/seed.py) and the generated
portraits (tools/avatars/generate_bot_avatars.sh). Character data used to live as an INSERT
in supabase/schema.sql AND as trait flags in the avatar script; with 30 of them that would
be two 30-row blobs guaranteed to drift.
`skill` ascends across the file and IS the rung order — tools/ingest/ladder.py sorts by it
and assigns 1:1, so rung N is the Nth entry here.
`style` drives BotSolver's policy (5 of each of the 6). `palette` cycles through the 6
BotPalette colourways (5 of each) — they are design-system role tokens, not free colours,
so 30 characters necessarily share them; style and portrait carry the distinctness.
Portrait traits are open-peeps variants — see the avatar script for why that style. Every
head is distinct across the 30. `hair` is pinned as deliberately as `head`: left random it
gave a sixty-something archivist ginger hair.

bots.name: Toby
bots.tagline: Three weeks in. Already certain.
bots.style_line: Answers before the question finishes. Right about as often as that sounds.
bots.backstory: Discovered the sport during one very good playoff run and has been extrapolating from it ever since. Has never seen a bad game, because he hasn't seen many games.
bots.head: short1

bots.name: Kyle
bots.tagline: Armchair expert in basically nothing.
bots.style_line: Fast and streaky. Nails the obvious ones and guesses at everything close.
bots.backstory: Started following the sport eleven months ago and has opinions about all of it. Will tell you the ceiling comparison for a player who has played four games.
bots.head: short2

voice.intro: I've been watching a LOT of film.
voice.behind: This is fine. This is fine.

bots.name: Bex
bots.tagline: Ranked #4 in the world. In the video game.
bots.style_line: Reflex-fast, and treats every call like a buzzer round.
bots.backstory: Knows every player's attributes to two decimal places and has never watched a full ninety minutes. Insists this is a technicality.
bots.head: mohawk

bots.name: Ray
bots.tagline: Been watching since before you were a rumour.
bots.style_line: Slow to start, and then suddenly remembers everything.
bots.backstory: Sixty years in front of the same television in the same chair. Couldn't tell you a single advanced metric and could tell you what the weather was like.
bots.head: grayMedium

voice.intro: Take your time. I've got all day.

bots.name: Simone
bots.tagline: Goes to two games a year. Remembers both.
bots.style_line: Quiet start, and much harder to shake in the back half than she looks.
bots.backstory: Not a fan exactly. Just pays close attention to things, and the sport happens to be a thing she has paid attention to for a while now.
bots.head: bun2

bots.name: Dev
bots.tagline: Reads every preview. Never the recap.
bots.style_line: Deliberate and well-informed right up until something actually happened.
bots.backstory: Consumes an enormous amount of analysis about games that have not been played yet, and loses interest the moment they are.
bots.head: short3

voice.intro: I have a projection for this.

bots.name: Marisol
bots.tagline: One club. Everything about it.
bots.style_line: Encyclopaedic in a narrow lane, guesswork everywhere else.
bots.backstory: Can name every player to wear the shirt since 1994, including the ones who never got off the bench. Could not name three players on any other team.
bots.head: longCurly

voice.lose: Ask me about the other lot.
voice.playerPerfect: You're not one of us, are you?

bots.name: Otto
bots.tagline: Runs the pub quiz. Marks his own answers.
bots.style_line: Uncannily right, with the occasional total blank he'll never explain.
bots.backstory: Has been the final authority on sporting arguments in one specific pub for nineteen years, a position he holds through confidence rather than accuracy.
bots.head: shaved1

bots.name: Priya
bots.tagline: Has a spreadsheet open for this.
bots.style_line: Deliberate. Excellent when the numbers are clear, lost when they are close.
bots.backstory: Keeps a spreadsheet. Has never watched a full game without a second screen open. If it is measurable she has measured it, and if it isn't she is suspicious of it.
bots.head: bun

voice.playerPerfect: I'd like to see your workings.

bots.name: Jonah
bots.tagline: First-time caller. Fourteen hundredth time.
bots.style_line: Steady, loud, and exactly as good as he is every single week.
bots.backstory: Phones the same radio show every Monday with the same complaint in a slightly different shape. The hosts know his voice and his postcode.
bots.head: flatTop

voice.win: I've been saying this for years.
voice.lose: You're wrong but I respect it.
voice.playerPerfect: Put this guy on the air.

bots.name: Inés
bots.tagline: Kept every programme. Every one.
bots.style_line: Brilliant on the forgotten ones, oddly shaky on the famous ones.
bots.backstory: Four filing cabinets of matchday programmes, indexed. Knows the squad numbers of players whose careers lasted a single substitute appearance.
bots.head: grayBun

voice.intro: I'll have a file on this.
voice.behind: That one's not in the cabinet.

bots.name: Curtis
bots.tagline: All-state. Once. Still mentions it.
bots.style_line: Attacks every question like it's a rep. Occasionally attacks the wrong one.
bots.backstory: Peaked at nineteen and has structured a personality around it. Genuinely does know what it feels like out there, which he will confirm for you.
bots.head: shaved2

voice.lose: You'd never have caught me at nineteen.

bots.name: Wanda
bots.tagline: Same seat, thirty-one years.
bots.style_line: Unremarkable early and genuinely dangerous once she's settled.
bots.backstory: Row F, seat 12. Has watched three generations of players from the same angle and can tell you which of them ran hard when it didn't matter.
bots.head: medium2

voice.playerPerfect: I'd have you in Row F.

bots.name: Marcus
bots.tagline: Twelve years behind a desk, four of them on TV.
bots.style_line: Metronomic. Rarely brilliant, never bad — you have to beat their average.
bots.backstory: Twelve years behind a desk, four of them on television. Can talk for ninety seconds about anything and has never once said he doesn't know.
bots.head: pomp

voice.ahead: And that's the story of the game.

bots.name: Femi
bots.tagline: Commissioner. Twelve years. Undefeated in rules disputes.
bots.style_line: Systematic and slow, and will not be rushed by your clock.
bots.backstory: Runs a fantasy league with a written constitution and an appeals process. Two friendships have not survived it. He considers the constitution vindicated.
bots.head: dreads1

voice.intro: I've read the rules. Have you?
voice.playerPerfect: I'd like to see your roster.

bots.name: Astrid
bots.tagline: Doesn't watch games. Reads lines.
bots.style_line: Sees the answer coming, and every so often looks straight past an easy one.
bots.backstory: Grew up behind the counter of her father's shop, learning that what people believe and what is true are two different markets. Prefers the gap between them.
bots.head: longBangs

voice.intro: I'll take the other side of that.

bots.name: Bruno
bots.tagline: Knows everyone. Nobody knows him.
bots.style_line: Deadly on the players nobody remembers. Overthinks the household names.
bots.backstory: Thirty years in the kit room. Has washed the shirts of four hundred professionals and can tell you which of them said thank you.
bots.head: hatBeanie

bots.name: Lila
bots.tagline: Twenty years. One beat. No days off.
bots.style_line: Relentlessly even. There is no bad night and no great one.
bots.backstory: Has filed from the same press box through four rebuilds, two relocations and one lockout. Has the home number of every coach who ever lied to her.
bots.head: mediumStraight

bots.name: Dee
bots.tagline: Saw them play in a gym in Nebraska.
bots.style_line: Backwards. Deadly on the obscure ones, overthinks the obvious.
bots.backstory: Forty thousand miles a year, mostly to places without a direct flight. Knows the third-string sophomore who is going to matter in four years.
bots.head: hatHip

voice.intro: I've had eyes on this one for a while.

bots.name: Yusuf
bots.tagline: Publishes the model. Doesn't explain it.
bots.style_line: Slow, exact, and unbothered by how close a call looks.
bots.backstory: His projections get quoted by people who would never admit to reading them. Has declined four jobs in the sport on the grounds that they would compromise the model.
bots.head: short4

bots.name: Greta
bots.tagline: Knew he was done a season before he did.
bots.style_line: Starts cautious and finishes clinical. Do not let it go long.
bots.backstory: Twenty-two years of hamstrings and shoulders. Can watch a player jog and tell you how many good years are left, which she does not enjoy being right about.
bots.head: bangs2

voice.playerPerfect: Nothing wrong with you at all.

bots.name: Cass
bots.tagline: Buzzes in before the question ends. Usually right.
bots.style_line: Blistering and reckless — takes the lead early and hands some of it back.
bots.backstory: National quiz champion twice, on categories she prepared for and two she didn't. Cannot physically wait for the end of a sentence.
bots.head: twists

bots.name: Tomás
bots.tagline: Saw all of it from ten feet away.
bots.style_line: Even-handed to a fault. No emotion, no swings, no gaps.
bots.backstory: Refereed for nineteen years and was shouted at by everyone in the sport at least once. Retains a memory for detail that nobody has ever thanked him for.
bots.head: noHair2

voice.intro: I'll be fair. I'm always fair.

bots.name: Ingrid
bots.tagline: Works for a club. Won't say which.
bots.style_line: Knows things before she should, and blanks entirely maybe once a run.
bots.backstory: Signed something on her first day that she takes extremely seriously. Will discuss the sport at length and has never once mentioned an employer.
bots.head: bantuKnots

voice.playerPerfect: We should talk. Off the record.

bots.name: Hal
bots.tagline: Owns the tape. All of it.
bots.style_line: Starts cold and gets stronger every card. Do not let it go long.
bots.backstory: A basement, climate-controlled, and a catalogue that runs deeper than the league's own. Slow to warm up and impossible to shake once he has.
bots.head: grayShort

voice.behind: Give me a moment with the tape.
voice.lose: I'll add you to the collection.
voice.playerPerfect: I'd like a copy of that.

bots.name: Solomon
bots.tagline: Wrote the book. Literally the book.
bots.style_line: Unbeatable on the forgotten decades, human on this one.
bots.backstory: Nine years of research, two of writing, and a definitive history that sold four thousand copies. Every one of them to someone who now knows more than you.
bots.head: noHair3

bots.name: Nadia
bots.tagline: Builds rosters for a living. Yours is bad.
bots.style_line: Cold, exact and entirely unhurried. The clock is your problem.
bots.backstory: Sits two seats from the general manager and is the reason for three decisions the fanbase hated and one they built a statue for.
bots.head: cornrows

bots.name: Rex
bots.tagline: Has a vote. Uses it against you.
bots.style_line: No weakness and no fireworks. Just a wall of correct answers.
bots.backstory: One of the small number of people who decide who is remembered forever. Takes it seriously enough to have made enemies of three separate generations.
bots.head: short5

bots.name: Wren
bots.tagline: No job anyone can name. Knows everyone's numbers.
bots.style_line: Very nearly perfect, with the occasional inexplicable blank.
bots.backstory: Turns up at everything. Has credentials for everything. Nobody has ever established who issues them, and at this point it would be rude to ask.
bots.head: long

bots.name: Nova
bots.tagline: Knew the answer before the question.
bots.style_line: Very nearly perfect — with the occasional inexplicable blank.
bots.backstory: No one is sure where they came from or what they do between matches. Has never been observed getting an easy one wrong, or a hard one right by luck.
bots.head: noHair1

voice.intro: I already know how this ends.
voice.ahead: As it was always going to.
voice.playerPerfect: You saw it too, didn't you.
